name: Expense Reimbursement Requests
description: Itemized reimbursement requests for job-related expenses and mileage; late requests are ineligible.
deadline: Within 60 days of the expense, and by July 31 for expenses from the fiscal year ending June 30
quote: The request must be submitted to the Business Office within 60 days of the date on which the expense was incurred; and Requests for reimbursement of any expenses incurred during any fiscal year ending June 30 must be submitted to the Business Office by July 31 of the following fiscal year.
